# Ogg Opus decoder

The independently loaded `ogg-opus-decoder-1.7.5.min.js` is the unmodified `package/dist/ogg-opus-decoder.min.js` from [ogg-opus-decoder 1.7.5](https://registry.npmjs.org/ogg-opus-decoder/-/ogg-opus-decoder-1.7.5.tgz). SHA-256 `c5055d3410ca02728d10708e154b47219c38ceef52155f18702e34204150651f`.

The package's [upstream source at d2abc8e](https://github.com/eshaz/wasm-audio-decoders/tree/d2abc8ebe4ab3a322475934be141bc11f1af0419) includes build instructions and dependency versions. The accompanying upstream source map contains the bundled JavaScript source. Its SHA-256 is `f871956f2c9415555468d54f385ff79a6b5d32de400f36ae7d542d195b069b5b`.
